integrity: An elementary six-chamber analytic proof is supplied and a standalone program reproduces numerical checks; no independent certification is asserted.
scientific_limitations: Exact result for Haar-uniform central sections of the regular truncated cube only, not translated planes or other truncation parameters; numerical tests are supplementary. Historical priority and independent validation remain unestablished. The quadrilateral marginal is prior work.
title: The complete Haar central-section side-count law of the regular truncated cube
